name: mod
usage: /mod (the mods in Mods/Binaries/: loaded ones with their version, kind and hooks, and why the others are not)

name: mod_reload
usage: /mod_reload [id] (reload one mod and the mods that depend on it from its folder, or every mod; their state starts over)

name: mod_enable
usage: /mod_enable <id> (load a mod, now and at every start)

name: mod_disable
usage: /mod_disable <id> (unload a mod and the mods that depend on it, now and at every start)

name: raw
usage: /raw <hex> (send one S→C message)

name: set_speed
usage: /set_speed <percent> (100 = normal)

name: set_stat
usage: /set_stat <stat name or client key> <value|off> (off removes the dev replacement)

name: stat
usage: /stat <stat name or client key> (dev: current character stat value)

name: spawn_mob
usage: /spawn_mob <MonsterVarieties row, Id or name>[@level] [friendly] [normal|magic|rare|unique] [name]

name: item
usage: /item <BaseItemTypes row, Id, name or unique> [count] [magic|rare] (into the inventory, e.g. /item Small Life Flask 2, /item Iron Ring rare, /item Mageblood)

name: stash_place
usage: /stash_place <x> <y> <degrees> (dev: move and turn the stash of this area until you leave it; it opens from its new cell)

name: guild_stash_place
usage: /guild_stash_place <x> <y> <degrees> (dev: move and turn the guild stash of this area until you leave it)

name: delve_crawler
usage: /delve_crawler [x y degrees] (dev: create the Delve Crawler in the Azurite Mine Encampment, or move and turn the one there; a click on it opens the Subterranean Chart)

name: wp_place
usage: /wp_place [x y degrees] (dev: move and turn this area's waypoint; without arguments shows where it is)

name: wp_state
usage: /wp_state active <n> | bits all|none|area|<bit> | model <.ao> (dev: recreate this area's waypoint with StateMachine "active" n or another model, or send 0x4c with all, no, this area's or one bit, to find what lights it)

name: sulphite
usage: /sulphite <amount 0-65535> (dev: the character's Voltaxic Sulphite, saved and sent as the Delve data 0x228)

name: item_tab
usage: /item_tab <stash tab name> <count> (dev: up to count, at most {ItemTabMax}, more of every item type that has its own slot on that tab, as far as each slot holds, e.g. /item_tab Currency 1000)

name: adorned
usage: /adorned [0-1000] (dev: The Adorned unique jewel into the inventory, corrupted, for passive-jewel testing; the normal item range is 0-100)

name: unique_jewel
usage: /unique_jewel <name> | list (dev: a global unique jewel, max-rolled, into the inventory)

name: radius_jewel
usage: /radius_jewel <name> | list (dev: a radius unique jewel, max-rolled, into the inventory; pilot: the six attribute-conversion jewels)

name: impossible_escape
usage: /impossible_escape <keystone> | list (dev: Impossible Escape for that keystone, into the inventory)

name: tattoo
usage: /tattoo <name> | list (dev: a tattoo currency item into the inventory)

name: tattoo_apply
usage: /tattoo_apply <tattoo name> <node> (dev: apply a pilot tattoo to an allocated passive)

name: journey_makanui
usage: /journey_makanui <node> [keystone] (dev: apply Journey Makanui, random or chosen)

name: tattoo_remove
usage: /tattoo_remove <node> (dev: remove the tattoo from a passive)

name: timeless
usage: /timeless <name> [seed] [conqueror] | list (dev: a Legion timeless jewel into the inventory; Elegant Hubris seeds are the displayed x20 values 2000-160000)

name: voices
usage: /voices [1|3|5|7] (dev: the Voices unique Large Cluster Jewel with that many empty passives, into the inventory)

name: cluster_jewel
usage: /cluster_jewel <small|medium|large> [passives] [sockets] [theme mod] [notable mod ...] (dev: a non-unique cluster jewel with its enchantments, into the inventory; defaults 3/4/8 passives and 0/1/2 sockets)

name: corrupt
usage: /corrupt (dev: marks the held item corrupted, e.g. to make a corrupted magic jewel)

name: gem
usage: /gem <name> [level] [quality] (a gem into the inventory at that level and quality, e.g. /gem Fireball 20 20, /gem Ice Nova of Frostbolts, /gem Vaal Fireball 5)

name: gem_xp
usage: /gem_xp <amount|near> (dev: set the experience of every gem in the inventory and the sockets; near = one below the next level's threshold)

name: map_portal
usage: /map_portal [type 1-4] [created 0|1] [open after ms, -1 never] [model 0-2] (dev: one MultiplexPortal next to you, listed in the map device's 0x8f)

name: cosmetic
usage: /cosmetic portal <name, number or part of a name> | /cosmetic list [filter] | /cosmetic off (the portal cosmetic: the shop effect replaces the base portal visual)

name: portal_rotation
usage: /portal_rotation <degrees> (dev: turn the map portals around the vertical axis; rebuilds the ones standing)

name: item_mod
usage: /item_mod [implicit|explicit|enchant|scourge|hidden] <Mods row, Id or part of it> [values…] | /item_mod set [section] <mod> [values…] | /item_mod clear [section] (the held item; missing values are rolled)

name: roll
usage: /roll <magic|rare> [item level] (new affixes and name for the held item)

name: item_mods
usage: /item_mods (the held item's rarity and mods)

name: base_defence
usage: /base_defence [0 to 31] (show or set the held armour's shared defence base roll)

name: rarity
usage: /rarity <normal|magic|rare|unique> [unid] (the held item)

name: sockets
usage: /sockets [colours] (the held item's sockets: R G B W, linked within a word, e.g. /sockets RRGBBB a 6-link, /sockets RRG B a 3-link and a single; without colours, shows them; Game_SOCKET_CAPACITY=1..6 lets any socketable base take that many, e.g. a 6-link wand)

name: set_level
usage: /set_level <1 to 100> (saved to the account; the level's experience and stats are sent at once)

name: add_xp
usage: /add_xp <amount> (experience as from a kill: levels up, saved)

name: passives
usage: /passives (passive skill points and the allocated passives)

name: ascendancy
usage: /ascendancy [normal|phrecia] [name] (list or choose; Phrecia play is gated pending client compatibility)

name: ascendancy_points
usage: /ascendancy_points <normal|cruel|merciless|eternal|all> (dev: grant each Labyrinth's two ascendancy points once)

name: reset_ascendancy
usage: /reset_ascendancy (refund all ascendancy nodes; five refund points per node/effect, choice shells are free)

name: gold
usage: /gold <amount> (dev: add gold, or take it with a negative amount; the account's, saved)

name: add_passive_points
usage: /add_passive_points <n> (dev: add n extra passive skill points, saved)

name: add_refund_points
usage: /add_refund_points <n> (dev: add n refund points, saved)

name: add_passive
usage: /add_passive <PassiveSkillGraphId> [...] (dev: allocate a connected set of passive nodes)

name: reset_passives
usage: /reset_passives (refunds every passive, saved)

name: resistances
usage: /resistances (your uncapped and capped fire/cold/lightning/chaos resistance)

name: hit
usage: /hit <fire|cold|lightning|chaos|physical> <damage> (dev: incoming enemy test contact through resistances or armour)

name: suppression
usage: /suppression (Spell Suppression chance, roll and damage reduction)

name: suppression_luck
usage: /suppression_luck <lucky|unlucky|off> (dev: force a lucky/unlucky suppression roll)

name: accuracy
usage: /accuracy [monster level] (accuracy rating and attack hit chance; default: your level)

name: defences
usage: /defences [monster level] (armour, evasion and avoidance; default: your level)

name: auras
usage: /auras (active auras, their reservation and the character's efficiency)

name: spellhit
usage: /spellhit <fire|cold|lightning|chaos|physical> <damage> (dev: spell hit through resistance and Spell Suppression)

name: crit
usage: /crit (attack and spell critical strike chance and multiplier)

name: block
usage: /block (attack and spell block chance and caps)

name: block_luck
usage: /block_luck <attack|spell|both|off> (dev: force lucky block)

name: blockhit
usage: /blockhit <attack|spell> <fire|cold|lightning|chaos|physical> <damage> (dev: hit through block and resistance)

name: god
usage: /god (toggles: 1000% increased attack and cast speed, 100% of life and 10 000 mana regenerated per second, 200% increased area of effect, +10 000 life, +1000 attributes)

name: set_aoe
usage: /set_aoe <percent> | off (dev: the character's increased area of effect, base_skill_area_of_effect_+%, in place of what passives, items and /god give)

name: heal
usage: /heal (full life; also revives: 0x1b1 from 0 runs the client's revive)

name: death_screen
usage: /death_screen [hex flags] (show the death screen; default: this league's; 2 hides it)

name: transition
usage: /transition [pos [here | x y | +dx +dy] | rot <degrees> | z <z | none> | model <path | none> | index <n>]

name: quest_flag
usage: /quest_flag [<QuestFlags Id> [off]] (dev: list, set or clear quest flags, e.g. /quest_flag a1q1-KilledHillock)

name: delve_chart
usage: /delve_chart <u32> <u16> [<u16> <u16> <u64> <u8> <u32> ...] (dev: what the next Delve chart (S→C 0x240) carries, to work out its fields)

name: atlas
usage: /atlas [layout] (dev: show or choose the fallback layout generic maps open)

name: atlas_tree
usage: /atlas_tree (dev: open the Atlas passive tree; S→C 0x7b kind 0x11)

name: atlas_points
usage: /atlas_points [<n>] (dev: show or set the Atlas passive point budget, saved)

name: goto
usage: /goto <area id or name> [seed] (dev: change area as if through an area transition, e.g. /goto 1_1_3; with a seed, a new instance at that seed, e.g. /goto 1_1_5 1384217569)

name: tour
usage: /tour <list file> | stop | status (dev, live.ps1 -Walkmaps: visit every "<area id> <seed>" of the file in a new instance and record it; levelgen tourlist writes one)

name: league_flag
usage: /league_flag [<id> [off]] (dev: list, set or clear league quest flags by the client's id, e.g. /league_flag 350)

name: hideout_keys
usage: /hideout_keys <a> <b> (dev: the Player component's two Hideouts.dat keys, HASH16 hex or a hideout area id)

name: waypoints
usage: /waypoints [all | reset] (list the activated waypoints; dev: activate all and visit every pinned area, or keep only the towns')

name: npc
usage: /npc <NPCs row, Id or name> [rotation°] (spawns an NPC next to you)

name: npc_place
usage: /npc_place <name> <x> <y> <degrees> (dev: move and turn an NPC here)

name: npc_face
usage: /npc_face <name> <degrees> (turn an NPC here)

name: ui
usage: /ui <kind hex> [a] [b] [c] [d] (S→C 0x7b open a UI)

name: npcs
usage: /npcs (list NPCs here)

name: pos
usage: /pos (your cell)

name: game_data
usage: /game_data reload | reference | mod <mod> <stat> <min> <max> | clear_mod <mod> [stat] | limit <key> <value> | clear_limit <key> | setting <key> <value> | clear_setting <key> | settings | list (dev: SQLite game-data overrides; no restart)

name: lastpackets
usage: /lastpackets [n] (dev: the connection's last n messages, both directions, to the Gateway log; default 64)

name: tp
usage: /tp <x> <y> | <+dx> <+dy> | <id> | <name> [n] | list [filter] (dev: teleport to a cell, a monster, NPC, transition, waypoint or captured object, e.g. /tp RhoaChest 2)

name: mobs
usage: /mobs (list spawned monsters)

name: despawn
usage: /despawn [all | <id>] (default: the last one spawned)

name: mob_move
usage: /mob_move [id] [speed] (0x1ba toward you; default the last monster, speed 20)

name: mob_walk
usage: /mob_walk [id] [skill hex] (0x1ab Move toward you)

name: anim
usage: /anim <index> [speed] (0x1b2 kind 0: play an animation on the nearest monster)

name: mob_mods
usage: /mob_mods [id] [mod …|pool] (a monster's mods; with mods: create it again with those affixes, e.g. /mob_mods Quick of_Flames)

name: mob_tp
usage: /mob_tp [id] (0x1b7 next to you; default the last monster)

name: ai
usage: /ai [on|off] (monsters chase you when you come near; emerge monsters rise either way)
